scope.description: Version-bound pilot: three scalar parameters, fourteen Load attributes and their ordered container independently recovered from cached native exports and an actual owned offline official GUI. Fourteen genuine GUI cases passed; runtime dependencies/sentinels, structural CRUD, malformed references, overflow, icon edits, all deadline values, dirty-cancel rollback and customization-flag transitions remain unverified. Synthetic fixtures are implementation data only. No claim of whole-file byte parity or production/live execution. See tests\ux\energy-manager2\field-bindings.json for units, encodings, observed limits and preservation rules.

binding.reason: O is Offset grid power parameter, not output; kW, default 0, signed values. Positive permits import/storage draw; negative reserves export/storage charge. Invariant decimal XML; decimal-comma GUI verified -1.25 and 2.75.
Percent; default 0, catalog 0..100 inclusive; GUI 0/100 verified. Values above zero document storage-charge priority, but runtime dependency execution is separately unknown.
Maximum storage charging power, kW; default/minimum 0, no catalog upper bound. 5.5 and 0 saved. Zero runtime sentinel meaning is separately unknown.
Twelve direct records including unused slots; XML order is priority 1..12. Reorder whole records without renumbering OIdx or changing Id/references. Structural add/delete remains unknown.
Persistent UUID preserved with record attributes during priority moves. Missing/duplicate identity validation is not claimed.
Boolean output-connected/used flag; absent false. Not an enable checkbox: connected load retains U=true at rated power zero.
Editable load name string; native name setter marks Ncu. GUI renamed the same L1 identity to Pilot Alpha.
Boolean customization marker: recovered native name setter sets it to 1. GUI sample already had true; false-to-true transition is explicitly not verified.
Boolean false/absent Digital; true Analog. GUI selector and saved XML independently verified. Not inferred from abbreviation.
Boolean customization marker: native type setter sets it to 1. Sample initially true; false-to-true GUI transition unverified.
Integer zero-based output L(OIdx+1), 0..11 in twelve-slot model. NOT priority; original OIdx stays with its load during GUI sorting.
Integer seconds, default 60; preparation time GUI 30..86400. Native setter clamps below 30. GUI accepted/saved both endpoints; attempted zero retained previous 30.
Integer seconds, absent 0; GUI minutes convert via QVariant::toInt then x60. 1,5 rounds to 2 =>120; -1 min accepted/saved -60. No invented nonnegative validator; overflow domain unverified.
Integer seconds, absent 0; GUI minutes/day 0..1440, integer conversion x60. 5=>300 and 1440=>86400 saved. Attempt 1441 became 144=>8640 by prefix filtering.
Integer selector default0; native 0 Sunset,1 Dusk,2 Sunrise,3 Dawn,4..27 01:00..24:00. Only Sunset/Dusk GUI-save verified; daily-cycle runtime and all remaining selections separately unverified.
Double kW, default/minimum0. Setting zero substitutes current MaxPwr. Digital SwPwr>MaxPwr is allowed. Native setter and GUI 0->2.5 with rated2.5 verified.
Double kW, default/minimum0. Zero accepted and omitted in XML; existing U=true remains; row pink. Native rated setter substitutes its value into SwPwr if SwPwr was zero.
UUID icon reference preserved during tested record edits/reordering. Picker CRUD/reference validation is explicitly not GUI-tested.
Actual first-row Up disabled and Down enabled; native checks selected index against 0 and record count minus1.
Observed unused rows pink and connected zero-rated row pink. Native pink condition is U==0 OR MaxPwr<=0; GUI label explicitly identifies unconnected outputs as unused.

Actual first save upgraded V172->178, colors and CF=true->FLG=2. Entire file bytes/UUID multiset differ. Reorder preservation comparisons are against the GUI-saved baseline, never globally stripped UUIDs.
Documented Soc/Spwr/MinSoc priority behavior was not exercised by an offline GUI SPS oracle.
MaxSpwr zero/default accepted; runtime zero interpretation not verified. Do not assume unlimited charging or disabled storage.
Deadline/day-cycle output behavior not executed; no production schedules or alarms touched.
No add/delete controls observed; dynamic/sparse/missing/>12-row acceptance and structural CRUD not executed.
Duplicate load Id/OIdx and dangling connector/icon reference diagnostics not executed.
Scientific/non-finite/overflow inputs and integer conversion overflow not executed; typed-prefix filtering is not a complete CLI parser policy.
Exploratory Cancel closed a dialog, but no accepted dirty edit was cancelled; rollback behavior not verified.

cases.condition: Public offline sample, all scalar defaults
cases.procedure: Open owned disposable project, select Energy Manager, inspect widgets, save baseline, inspect Co Def storage.
cases.expected: All three widgets 0; baseline omits Def and preserves scalar connector identities.

cases.condition: Signed fractional O with locale-correct decimal separator
cases.procedure: Enter -1,25 then later 2,75 in owned GUI O widget; save and independently inspect invariant Def.
cases.expected: O is Offset grid power parameter; saved Def -1.25 and 2.75.

cases.condition: MinSoc zero, upper endpoint and attempted over-bound entry
cases.procedure: Enter100, attempt101 while previous100, then enter0; save and record actual widget/storage feedback.
cases.expected: 100 and0 accepted; attempt101 remains100 in observed session; zero Def omitted. Do not substitute CLI rejection text for GUI filtering.

cases.condition: Storage power positive fractional, zero/default and attempted negative
cases.procedure: Enter5,5 then attempt-1; capture widget and saved scalar Def.
cases.expected: 5.5 saved; attempted-1 produces0 and saved Def omission. Runtime-zero semantics not covered.

cases.condition: Three connected loads plus nine unused fixed slots
cases.procedure: Open actual Edit Energy Manager dialog; enumerate all headers, rows and controls and inspect screenshot.
cases.expected: 12 rows,11 headers, empty unused rows pink, no add/delete controls; outputs differ from priority indices.

cases.condition: Rename and Digital-to-Analog edit of existing customized load
cases.procedure: Rename L1 to Pilot Alpha, choose Analog, accept/save, compare field values and identity.
cases.expected: Na Pilot Alpha and An=true; Id/OIdx/icon unchanged; Ncu/Anc stay true, not evidence of false-to-true transition.

cases.condition: Preparation-time endpoints and attempted zero
cases.procedure: Set30, attempt0 from30, set86400; save and inspect RT.
cases.expected: 30/86400 saved seconds; attempted0 retains30; no confusion with MinRt minutes.

cases.condition: Minimum runtime whole, negative and fractional minute entry
cases.procedure: Set2 min, -1 min and locale-correct1,5 min in separate saved observations.
cases.expected: MinRt=120,-60,120 respectively; actual negative accepted, fractional rounds via integer conversion.

cases.condition: Daily5/1440-minute values, attempted1441 and Dusk selector
cases.procedure: Set5 min/day and Dusk; save. Set1440, attempt1441 and capture prefix filtering; separately save1440.
cases.expected: MDay300,tpR1; attempted1441 becomes144=>8640; saved1440=>86400. Baseline Sunset tpR omitted.

cases.condition: Switch-on zero with positive rated power and allowed greater-than-rated switch-on
cases.procedure: Record original digital2.6/2.5; set switch-on0 at rated2.5, accept/save.
cases.expected: SwPwr2.5 substituted. Existing SwPwr2.6>MaxPwr2.5 is accepted, not invalid universal relation.

cases.condition: Already-connected analog load assigned zero rated power
cases.procedure: Enter rated0, inspect actual row color and saved Load attributes.
cases.expected: MaxPwr omitted (zero); U=true/SwPwr2.5 retained; actual row pink.

cases.condition: Move first priority down with real existing wire and icon references
cases.procedure: Select first load, press Down, accept/save; compare ordered complete Load dictionaries by Id and all UUID spellings against preceding GUI-saved output.
cases.expected: First two records exchange order only; Id/OIdx/icon/complete attributes and non-Load subtree/wire identities unchanged.

cases.condition: First-row selection and one downward move
cases.procedure: Select first row, capture button enabled states, press Down and capture actual priority/output association.
cases.expected: Up disabled, Down enabled; same L1 load moves to priority2, L2 to priority1.

cases.condition: Public V172 sample first saved by actual version-bound GUI
cases.procedure: Save disposable project and compare exact input/output without sanitizing XML or globally stripping UUIDs.
cases.expected: Observed V172->178/color/CF->FLG conversion; full file identity not claimed. All Energy Load dictionaries and connector identities unchanged.

cases.condition: Soc below/at/above MinSoc with storage inputs
cases.procedure: Future safe offline SPS oracle must independently execute storage priority, not just open an edit dialog.
cases.expected: Record actual output behavior and diagnostics; currently not run.

cases.condition: MaxSpwr zero while storage priority active
cases.procedure: Future offline SPS oracle must distinguish zero/default behavior without assuming a sentinel meaning.
cases.expected: Currently unverified; no unlimited/disabled-storage guess.

cases.condition: Daily minimum runtime before/after deadline and day rollover
cases.procedure: Future disposable offline SPS oracle with controlled synthetic time only; never household alarm/schedule mutation.
cases.expected: Actual daily-cycle output and feedback; currently not run.

cases.procedure: Future safe offline projects must establish real supported structural operations and feedback.
cases.expected: Currently unverified; fixed-row edit/reorder does not establish dynamic CRUD.

cases.condition: Duplicate load identities/output associations or dangling references
cases.procedure: Future disposable offline cases must capture exact acceptance/rejection/diagnostics while preserving unrelated references.
cases.expected: Currently unverified; successful reference preservation does not establish invalid-reference diagnostics.

cases.condition: Non-finite/scientific/overflow numeric values
cases.procedure: Future bounded offline numeric oracle must establish parser/precision/conversion behavior.
cases.expected: Currently unverified; catalog infinity means no stated finite bound, not permission to serialize NaN/Infinity.

cases.procedure: Future disposable dialog case must accept a changed field, Cancel, save and compare to preceding output.
cases.expected: Currently unverified; prior exploratory Cancel is not counted as dirty rollback.

cases.procedure: Future owned offline icon picker oracle must save an independently identified selected reference.
cases.expected: Currently not run; preserved icon identity is not CRUD parity.

cases.condition: Every deadline selector value including hourly values
cases.procedure: Future GUI-save cases must independently bind native enum values2..27 and invalid boundaries.
cases.expected: Currently not run beyond Sunset/Dusk; native enumeration is not complete GUI-save evidence.

cases.procedure: Future safe project must establish false-to-true marker transitions separately from native setter recovery.
